title: Repeated failed console sign-ins
description: A synthetic identity scenario recorded repeated failed console sign-ins.
evidence_summary: Twenty-three failed sign-in attempts across three fabricated source addresses in eight minutes.

title: Storage policy allows public access
description: A simulated configuration check detected a public-read bucket policy.
evidence_summary: A test policy grants read access to an unauthenticated principal.

title: Unusual API activity from a new region
description: A fabricated principal accessed an unfamiliar set of read-only actions.
evidence_summary: The activity differs from the sample principal's baseline region and service mix.

title: Unused access key is older than policy allows
description: The sample access key has not been used recently and exceeds the rotation window.
evidence_summary: Last use is outside the configured 90-day review window.

title: Database snapshot is not encrypted
description: A synthetic database snapshot missed the encryption control during creation.
evidence_summary: The sample snapshot was created without the expected encryption flag.
resolution_reason: The snapshot was replaced with an encrypted synthetic copy.

title: Security group exposes an unused test port
description: A lab-only security group includes a port used by a retired test fixture.
evidence_summary: The port is not referenced by active services in the synthetic account.
resolution_reason: Confirmed as an isolated lab fixture with no active workload attached.
